result:
I reviewed the actual diff against the PR #561 audit's cross-tenant governance bypass finding, not just the self-report. The fix is architecturally sound: I traced `getPromptLifecycleRule()`/`checkPromptEvalBudget()` end-to-end, confirmed no call site still threads an `orgId` into them, and verified directly in `module-rule-service.ts` that `WRITABLE_SCOPE_TYPES` genuinely excludes `'platform'` — so this is a real structural fix, not a bypassable role check. The Luhn-based PII regex tightening and new regression tests (which reproduce the exact audited exploit) also check out. The one documented residual limitation (org-scoped ABAC evaluated against a platform-wide resource) is safe because I confirmed the ABAC system is deny-only with no escalation path.

**Verdict: approve** (tier2 — holds for your sign-off, not auto-mergeable). Wrote `review-verdict.json` to the repo root. Minor non-blocking notes: `ACTIVE-CLAIMS.yaml` has a pre-existing YAML parse error unrelated to this diff, and the new migration still needs to be applied live by a human.
